global.description: Global stunnel configuration (applies to all services unless overridden)

setuid.description: User to run stunnel as (recommended: 'nobody' for security)

setgid.description: Group to run stunnel as (recommended: 'nogroup' for security)

foreground.description: Run in foreground (useful for containers; set to false for daemon mode)

cert.description: Path to SSL certificate chain file (must include private key or be paired with 'key' below)

key.description: Path to private key file (leave empty if key is embedded in 'cert')

options.description: OpenSSL options — disable weak protocols and features

cacheSize.description: Size of session cache (only relevant for 'builtin' cache)

services.description: List of services to proxy. Each service defines an accept port → connect endpoint mapping

name.description: Service name (must be unique; used as section header)

accept.description: Host:port (or just port) on which stunnel listens for client connections

connect.description: Host:port (or just port) of the backend server to forward to (can be 'localhost:PORT' or remote)

client.description: If true, stunnel acts as a client toward the 'connect' server (required for outbound proxies or client-mode TLS)

sni.description: SNI hostname to use when connecting to upstream server (for upstream TLS)

verify.description: Certificate verification level (0 = none, 1 = peer cert required, 2 = peer cert + chain, 3 = peer cert + chain + CRL)

cafile.description: Path to CA certificate file for verification (only used if 'verify' > 0)

cadir.description: Path to directory of CA certificates (alternative to 'cafile')

ciphers.description: Cipher list specific to this service (overrides global 'options')

protocol.description: Protocol to use (e.g., 'smtp', 'pop3') for protocol-specific handling

enabled.description: If false, service section is commented out (disabled)
